positions.title: Lead Front End Engineer
positions.description:
Managed/mentored two separate teams with 3-5 front-end developers each
Helped architect and implement new and redesigned admin tools for dealers
Created a React component-based system for standardizing common styles and functionality across the platform
Improved a common component library by using some open source software along with custom scripts to make dependency management much easier
Introduced Flow to the team in order to add type safety, increase confidence in the code that got shipped, and reduce the amount of mental overhead required to implement large features
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Redux · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · React · Software Architecture · JavaScript · Web Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · TypeScript · Git · GraphQL · Web Services · Databases · Web Applications · RESTful WebServices

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
Worked on several line of business applications using C#/WPF which were used by fund accountants to report on positions and trades.
Developed WCF service to handle firm-wide FTP and SFTP downloads, to replace legacy RoboFTP scripts.
Responsible for setting development standards and providing guidance for new application development using Web API and Angular.JS.
Created and deployed a dashboard application using Angular.JS that was designed in a modular fashion, to make it easy for other developers to add self-contained "applets" to it.
Contributed to software development lifecycle meetings to determine firm-wide guidelines and practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · AngularJS · JavaScript · Web Development · SQL · C# · Git · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET · Databases

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing software to trade various markets automatically by means of mathematical models.
Streamlined back office and middle office operations such as P&L calculation, trade blotters, and resolving discrepancies between internal trade history and broker statements.
Developed an application used by researchers to evaluate a trading strategy and determine the best parameters to use for it in any given market.
Involved in research to develop new trading strategies and methods.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET · Databases

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Worked in both the web services and investment support groups
Involved in creation of software to manage various databases and provide users with desired reports
Improved functionality of certain areas of the company intranet
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET · Databases

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Designed web applications for a variety of clients in different industries
Maintained relationships with clients to gather requirements and obtain feedback on work completed
Developed a Java applet which allowed the user to record audio through a web site and store it in a database for later retrieval
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL · C# · .NET · Databases

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst / Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for troubleshooting both software and hardware related issues
Involved in system administration of a Linux mail server
Maintained the company web site and added content and functionality to it by means of ASP, HTML, CSS, and Javascript
Created simple games in Flash which were added to the site
